narrative.overview: A bright white page centers a thin Star of David above a serif headline and one supporting sentence. Generous empty space, restrained colors, and a small domain label provide the entire visual hierarchy. This records the approved holding surface only.
keyCharacteristics: Centered serif headline and sans-serif supporting text.
Thin SVG mark with a continuous trace and restrained headline light wave.
dos: Do preserve the generous white space and centered hierarchy.
Do preserve the looping trace, pause control, and reduced-motion static state.
donts: Don't expand the visible body beyond the approved vague construction message.
